snippet.title: Summoner's Gambit | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The wait is over, summoners!

Summoner's Gambit, the strategy card battler fused with auto-chess mechanics officially launches on August 5, 2025 at 23:59 PDT / August 6 at 00:00 PT!

What awaits you:

Build your deck, master energy management
Fuse creatures from 4 races to create new beings
Outsmart opponents with tactical positioning
Challenge the unknown in a pixel Lovecraftian world

👉 Wishlist now on Steam:
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570110/_/]

#indiegames #dbgaming #autochess
